title: Hidden Trails of China and Japan | Group Tour Package
highlights: Discover the best of China and Japan, journeying through serene landscapes, ancient temples and treasures, offering an immersive experience of Asia's rich heritage.
Admire the grandeur of Beijing's Summer Palace, where imperial gardens, serene lakes, and exquisite pavilions reflect rich cultural heritage and architectural elegance.
Experience the serene beauty of Meiji Temple, a peaceful sanctuary in the heart of Tokyo, blending traditional Shinto architecture with lush forested grounds.
Capture the breathtaking views of Mount Fuji framed by cherry blossoms and the iconic Chureito Pagoda at Arakurayama Sengen Park, perfect blend of nature and tradition.
Explore the Peace Museum in Hiroshima, a memorial offering a powerful narrative of the atomic bomb's impact and a heartfelt call for global peace.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Beijing | Leisure Time at Wangfujing Street
days.desc: Welcome to Beijing! Upon arriving at the airport, you’ll be transferred to your hotel. After check-in, take some time to relax. In the evening, you will be driven to the vibrant Wangfujing Street, a renowned shopping area. Here, you can browse a wide range of shops, from luxury international brands to traditional Chinese boutiques. As night descends, the street comes alive with even more activity. Later, you will be driven back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Visit Great Wall of China | Leisure time in 798 Art District | Visit Temple of Heaven
days.desc: Today, you’ll be driven to visit the Mutianyu section of the Great Wall, where you'll ride a cable car to and from one of its most picturesque spots. Explore the commercial area and the Exhibition Center on the Wall. Afterwards, stroll through the 798 Art District before heading to the Temple of Heaven, one of China’s largest sacred complexes and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Then, enjoy a Tai Chi class and a foot massage before being driven back to your hotel.

days.title: Beijing City Tour
days.desc: In the morning, you will be transferred to Tiananmen Square, one of the largest squares in the world, where you will explore the National Centre For The Performing Arts. Next, visit the Great Chinese Imperial Palace, better known as the Forbidden City, followed by a stop at Jingshan Park to see Coal Hill. Next, you will take a tricycle ride through the traditional Hutong neighborhood. End your tour with a visit to the Summer Palace before being driven back to your hotel.

items.title: Beijing Capital Museum And The National Centre For The Performing Arts

days.title: Transfer to  Nanjing | Nanjing Sightseeing
days.desc: Today, check out from the hotel and get driven to the train station to board your high-speed train to Nanjing. Upon arrival, get transferred to explore Purple Mountain, known for its lush landscapes and historical importance. Discover the Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum, an impressive monument dedicated to the father of modern China. Following this, visit the charming Linggu Temple, renowned for its ancient pagodas & detailed carvings. Finally, get driven to your hotel and check in for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Shanghai via Suzhou and Tongli | En-route Sightseeing
days.desc: Post check out, you will get driven to Shanghai. En route, stop at Suzhou, where you will visit the Garden of the Humble Administrator. Following this, take a leisurely walk along Pingjiang Road, which boasts a history spanning over 800 years. Next stop will be Tongli, a water town with quaint houses along its canals and traditional gondolas. Enjoy a scenic boat ride on Tongli Lake, taking in the picturesque views. Continue on to Shanghai, and upon arrival, check in to your hotel.

days.title: Shanghai City Tour
days.desc: Today, you’ll be transferred to explore Shanghai’s iconic sites. Begin with the Pudong area, situated across the Huangpu River and renowned for its futuristic skyline. Continue with a walk through the Old City and visit Yuyuan Garden to experience a traditional tea ceremony demonstration. Afterwards, pass through the lively Xintiandi neighborhood, visit Tianzifang and the Bund, famous for their historic architecture. Finally, you’ll be driven back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Fly to Tokyo | Leisure Time in Shinjuku District
days.desc: Post check out, you will be driven to the airport for your flight to Tokyo (not included). After arriving at Tokyo Airport, get transferred to your hotel and check in. Later, you'll be transferred to Tokyo Station to take the metro (tickets included) to Shinjuku District. Enjoy your leisure time exploring Golden Gai's vibrant nightlife and the stunning landscapes of Shinjuku Gyoen. Afterward, you will board the metro to Tokyo station and return to the hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Check-in at Shinagawa Prince Hotel, Tokyo

days.title: Tokyo Sightseing Tour
days.desc: Today, you’ll be driven on a Tokyo sightseeing tour. Start with a visit to the historic Zojoji Temple, which contrasts beautifully with Tokyo Tower. Next, explore the renowned Meiji Temple and drive through the bustling Omotesando streets. Continue to the Imperial Palace and the Nijubashi Bridge, both notable landmarks. Discover Akihabara, the electric town, and visit the famous Sensoji Temple among other iconic attractions. Afterward, you’ll be driven back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Kawaguchiko | Arakurayama Sengen Park Tour | Kawaguchi Lake Boat Ride | Visit Mt. Fuji-5th Station
days.desc: In the morning, check out from the hotel and get transferred to Kawaguchiko. En route, you will visit the beautiful Arakurayama Sengen Park, admiring the views of the majestic Mount Fuji. Next, explore the historic Fuji Sengen Shrine, a significant cultural landmark. Enjoy a scenic boat ride on the picturesque Kawaguchiko Lake, then take a drive to the “fifth station” of Mount Fuji. Continue to Kawaguchiko, and upon arrival, check in to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Kyoto via Iyasi No Sato Nenba | Visit Shiraito Falls | Toyota Museum Tour
days.desc: Today, check out from the hotel and you’ll be transferred to Kyoto. Along the way, visit Iyashi no Sato Nenba, a village restored as a traditional open-air museum after a typhoon in 1966. Next, make a stop at the breathtaking Shiraito Falls, located within the Fuji-Hakone-Izu National Park. Continue with a visit to the renowned Toyota Museum to delve into Japan's automotive history before proceeding to Kyoto. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and enjoy an overnight stay.

items.title: Check-in at Super Deluxe Hotel
items.hotel: The Prince Kyoto Takaragaike, Autograph Collection

days.title: Kyoto Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: In the morning, get driven to explore Kyoto. Begin with a visit to the famous Arashiyama Bamboo Forrest, where you’ll cross the scenic Togetsukyo Bridge. Next, visit Tenryuji Temple, one of Kyoto's "five major Zen temples" and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Proceed to visit the Shinto Shrine of Fushimi Inari, the iconic Imperial Palace, and the golden Kinkakuji Temple. Later, get driven to the historic Gion district for leisure time before returning to the hotel on your own.

days.title: Transfer to Osaka via Nara | En-route Sightseeing
days.desc: Post check out, board the transfer from Kyoto to Osaka. On the way, stop in Nara to visit Todaiji, a grand Buddhist temple established in 752 that houses a towering giant Buddha. Also visit Horyu-ji, a World Heritage Site & one of Japan's oldest Buddhist temples. Continue to Osaka and check in to the hotel upon arrival. Later, get driven to visit Dotonbori, a lively district renowned for its bustling nightlife, shopping, and dining. Afterward, get driven back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Okayama | Visit to Himeji Temple | Korakuen Gardens Tour
days.desc: After checking out, you’ll be transferred to Okayama. On the way, stop in Himeji to explore its castle complex, a prime example of traditional Japanese architecture. Upon arriving in Okayama, you’ll be driven to Korakuen, one of Japan’s most beautiful gardens, featuring lakes, waterfalls, & teahouses. Next, visit the Shinto shrine of Kibitsu-Jinja, admiring its 360-meter-long corridor. Enjoy some free time in the lively city before being transferred to your hotel and check in for the night.

days.title: Transfer to Hiroshima via Kursahiki | Hiroshima Walking Tour | Visit to Itsukushima Shrine
days.desc: Post check out, you’ll be transferred to Hiroshima. On the way, stop in Kurashiki, known for its beautifully preserved historic center & charming old-world atmosphere. Continue towards Hiroshima, where upon arrival you’ll visit the Peace Memorial Park, the iconic dome, & the Peace Memorial Museum. Later, take a ferry to Miyajima to explore the Itsukushima Shrine, which is partially built over the sea. Afterwards, you’ll be transferred to your hotel in Hiroshima & check in for an overnight stay.

days.title: Departure
days.desc: In the morning, check out from your hotel in Hiroshima and continue your onward journey home. This marks the end of your trip.
